title: Use a fridge to cool items before disposal
description: Use this when a task requires placing a "cool" or chilled item somewhere, such as a garbage can.
content: To make an item cool, first locate and open a fridge, then use the "cool [item] with [fridge]" action while holding the item. After cooling, proceed to the target location and move the item there.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put a cool apple in garbagecan.

title: Search countertops for common produce items
description: Use this when looking for fruits or vegetables like apples that are not initially found in the fridge.
content: If a desired produce item is not in the fridge, check countertops and other surfaces in the environment. Pick up the item and examine it to confirm it is the correct object before proceeding with further actions.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put a cool apple in garbagecan.

title: Complete cooling tasks by moving the item to the target container
description: Use this after an item has been cooled and you need to finish a "put [item] in [container]" task.
content: Navigate to the specified container (e.g., garbage can) and use the "move [item] to [container]" action to place the cooled item inside. Ensure the item is in your inventory before moving to the container.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put a cool apple in garbagecan.

title: Use a microwave to heat objects when a stove burner is occupied or ineffective
description: Use this when you need to heat an object and placing it on a stove burner does not work.
content: To heat an object, first place it inside a microwave, then use the heat action with the microwave. Simply moving an object onto a stove burner or issuing a heat command without placing the object inside the appliance will not heat it.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put a hot apple in fridge.

title: Open containers before moving objects into them
description: Use this when you need to place an object into a closed appliance or container.
content: Before moving an object into a fridge or microwave, open the appliance first. Attempting to move an object into a closed appliance will fail, and the object must be in your inventory to be moved.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put a hot apple in fridge.

title: Verify object state after heating before final placement
description: Use this when a task requires an object to have a specific temperature state before being placed somewhere.
content: After heating an object, confirm the heating action succeeded before moving it to the final destination. If the object was placed in the destination without being properly heated, retrieve it, heat it with the correct appliance, and then place it back.
